licensure.disciplinary_grounds.rationale: These nine buckets capture the dominant recurring themes across all states: fraudulent acts in obtaining or exercising a license, criminal convictions, clinical negligence/incompetence, substance abuse impairing practice, non-substance physical/mental incapacity, broad unprofessional/unethical/sexual/immoral conduct, specific controlled-substance prescribing violations, false or misleading advertising, and procedural/administrative violations such as record-keeping, reporting, fee-splitting, aiding unlicensed practice, and out-of-state discipline.

profession_specific.board_certification_.rationale: The items cluster into two dominant podiatric surgery boards (ABFAS and ABPS), a podiatric medicine board (ABPM), orthopedic/osteopathic boards borrowed from adjacent professions, a multi-specialty or education-council body, and open-ended state-defined standards that accept any nationally recognized certifier.
